s: Gross Sales (ship date) = CALCULATE([Gross Sales], USERELATIONSHIP(FactSales[ShipDate], DimDate[Date])), likewise for posting date.
Note that ship-date value here is converted at the ship month's rate (that's how Operations' model does it), which also contributes to the difference.
dw-dims-0.check: Order date {{q1_2026_gross|money0}} vs ship date {{rev_ops_model|money0}} for Q1 2026.

s: SELECT DISTINCT Channel, Status, Currency → assign OrderFlagsKey with ROW_NUMBER.
Join the fact to it on the three columns at load time and keep only the key.

Building only the combinations that occur keeps the dimension small and meaningful; a full cross join is fine when it's tiny (here 20 rows) and you want new combinations to work without reloading the dimension.

code.title: dim_order_flags
src: WITH combos AS (SELECT DISTINCT Channel, Status, Currency FROM orders)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Combinations FROM combos;

s: Create a SegmentTier dimension (one row per Segment × Tier) and relate both DimCustomer and CustomerTargets to it (1:*).
Actual sales flow DimCustomer → FactSales; targets live at SegmentTier. A matrix by SegmentTier attributes shows both correctly.
At customer level, hide the target or show it as blank with ISINSCOPE: a segment target doesn't belong to one customer.
dw-dims-2.check: Targets show at Segment × Tier and above; blank (by design) at customer level.
